one_line: A personified guardian spirit of the Jogalthambi hoard of overstruck Nahapana–Gautamiputra Satakarni coins in the western Deccan, c. 1st–2nd century CE.

appearance.age_look: Appears about 18–20 years old, slim but athletic build with a light, poised stance.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp nose, medium-brown Deccan complexion, large expressive dark-brown eyes, a tiny beauty mark under the left eye, and a calm, focused default expression that hints at quiet determination.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair parted slightly off-center, pulled back into a smooth, high knot at the back of the crown (like an early topknot) wrapped with a narrow dark-red cloth band, with two loose side locks framing the cheeks and a few shorter strands at the nape.
appearance.costume: Era-appropriate unisex Deccan attire: a knee-length off-white cotton tunic (simple straight cut, half-sleeves just above the elbow, thin brown piping along the sleeve edges and hem), wrapped with a broad mustard-yellow cloth belt tied once at the front and falling as a short tab; below, a reddish-brown cotton dhoti tightly wrapped and pleated to mid-calf, with the pleats angled left and a narrow darker border at the edge; over the left shoulder a soft, dull-green cotton uttarīya (shawl) draped diagonally across the torso and looping around the right forearm, practical and modest; feet in simple brown leather sandals with a toe loop and ankle strap; jewellery kept modest and plausible for a village guardian: a pair of small round silver ear-studs, a thin silver torque-like neck ring, and a single narrow silver bangle on the right wrist, all slightly worn to evoke ancient coins; a small cloth pouch, grey with a faint diamond weave, is tied to the belt on the right hip, bulging subtly as if filled with coins.
appearance.signature: A broad, shallow, round coin-tray of darkened bronze held in the left hand, about the span of the forearm, its rim engraved with a subtle repeating wave motif; on the tray rest a few clearly visible silver karshapana-style coins showing faint traces of an earlier portrait beneath newer overstrikes, while in the right hand the spirit loosely holds a single overstruck coin between index finger and thumb, always glinting to catch light.

ref_desc: A slim, medium-brown young guardian with an oval face, high-knot black hair with side locks, off-white tunic, reddish-brown dhoti, mustard-yellow belt, dull-green shoulder shawl, simple silver jewellery, brown sandals, a grey coin-pouch, and a bronze tray of overstruck silver coins with one coin held up.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a slim, medium-brown young guardian spirit of the Jogalthambi hoard: an oval-faced character with large dark-brown eyes, a tiny beauty mark under the left eye, and a calm determined expression; thick black hair is parted slightly off-center and pulled into a smooth high knot wrapped with a narrow dark-red band, with two loose locks framing the cheeks and a few short strands at the nape. They wear an era-accurate early-1st–2nd century western Deccan outfit: a knee-length off-white cotton tunic with a straight cut, half-sleeves just above the elbow, and thin brown piping at the sleeve edges and hem; a broad mustard-yellow cloth belt tied once at the front with a short tab hanging down; a tightly wrapped reddish-brown cotton dhoti, pleated and falling to mid-calf with a slightly darker border at the edge; and a soft dull-green cotton shawl (uttarīya) draped from the left shoulder diagonally across the torso and looping around the right forearm for modest coverage. Show simple brown leather sandals with toe loop and ankle strap. Add modest jewellery: small round silver ear-studs, a thin silver neck ring, and a single narrow silver bangle on the right wrist, all worn and coin-like; tie a small grey cloth pouch with faint diamond weave, visibly full, to the belt on the right hip. In the left hand, the character carries a broad shallow round bronze coin-tray with a subtle wave motif on the rim, holding a few silver karshapana-like coins where traces of an older portrait are faintly visible beneath newer overstrikes, and in the right hand they hold a single overstruck coin up between thumb and index finger so it catches the light. Use a palette dominated by off-white, mustard yellow, reddish-brown, dull green, and silver, and present front and back views to clearly show hair, costume, and accessories.
